blockingFindings.description: Activating campaign 2 removes the campaign-title and featured-card image nodes. The active index changes, but the required campaign identity and card layer disappear.
At 390px the carousel controls are 56px targets but their text is transparent. The active control renders as a blank white square, unlike the official source's readable arrow controls.
The Demo uses a flat square white CTA without the official gold outline, rounded silhouette or arrow, and it visually merges into the next white section.

At a 1440px outer viewport desktop rules activate inside a roughly 347px phone proof surface, clipping navigation and overlapping the campaign title, card, CTA and controls. Hero scrollWidth is 506px against a 347px client width; active control text is white on white and targets are only about 42px high.

nonBlockingObservations: The default mobile crop and campaign mark are substantially closer to the official mobile source than Attempt 03.
The default mobile featured card uses the evidence-bound 2M6P_EN_23.png asset.
Machine geometry and active-index probes previously passed but did not detect the visually empty active control or missing slide-2 layers.

sourceComparison.finding: Default mobile art direction is credible, but control styling, changed-state completeness and the actual desktop proof surface diverge materially from the official source.
